fields.doc_05_hook: weapons: attack speed × 9000 joins §6.2's `atk_speed_bp` after the shortfall factor, and poise damage × 15000 joins §12.4 after the blunt factor, one `mul_bp` each; armor pieces: doc 11's +4 joins §11.2's per-piece `poise` before its chain

a reload never enters `Reloading`: on the tick §6.1 would start one, the rounds move from reserve to magazine at once (the shotgun loads every shell), the weapon stays `Ready` and doc 11 charges the HP; when doc 11 refuses the cost, no reload starts. A melee heavy spends doc 11's HP cost in place of §4.2's stamina
a "× N" trait: the charged shot's × 15000 multiplies `B` once after Canon §10.4 and before step 1 (§10.1)

the weapon has no magazine and spends no ammunition: §6.1 treats its magazine as always holding `ammo_per_shot` and never enters `Reloading`; a shot that brings doc 11's heat to 10000 moves the machine to `Stalled(0)` with `stall_total` 90 instead of `Ready`, and heat is 0 when `Stalled` ends
§7.3 step 2: a charged shot (doc 11) passes the first penetrable cell it enters without spending penetration, whatever its flight distance; fixed terrain stops it

magazine × 20000, and every reload duration of the weapon (§6.1 `reload_ticks`, the shotgun's 20-tick start and 32-tick per-shell interval, the 18-tick nock) × 13000, one `mul_bp` each before `action_ticks`
its per-shot and per-swing chance component draws at `seq` 0 in ascending ID (§1.4)

`input.throw` with such a melee weapon active and no throwable on the quickbar throws the weapon itself: a `move.throw` with §9.2's 12-tick minimum wind, 18-tick recovery and `seq` 0 action start, flying with `arch.ranged.thrown`'s Table 5.2b ballistics at §9.1's speed; its hit uses the weapon's own `base_mhp`, shares, `pen_bp`, impact and Canon §10.4 chain with move factor 10000, and it rolls Contradiction as a throw (§16.3 dud). While it is away the melee machine is `Holstered` and `input.attack` performs `arch.melee.unarmed` attacks; exactly 30 ticks after release it returns to the hand wherever it is and enters `Drawing(0)`
the bearer is immune to `st.disarmed` and `st.corroded`, buildup and direct application alike, so `counter.sunder` cannot corrode it (§15.1)
§7.3 step 2: after 10000 mm of flight its projectiles pass destructible and non-opaque cells without spending penetration; fixed terrain stops them
